hook: Pichle mahine se kitna badha? [[LAG]] peeche mud ke dekhta hai

slides.title: LAG = [[rear-view mirror]]
slides.note: Bike chalate waqt mirror: aage chalo, **peeche bhi dekho** 🏍️

slides.title: Pichla [[mahina]]
slides.code:
SELECT month, amount,
  LAG(amount) OVER
    (ORDER BY month_no) AS prev,
  amount - LAG(amount) OVER
    (ORDER BY month_no) AS growth
FROM sales;

slides.title: Growth [[nikli]]
slides.note: Jan ke peeche koi nahi → **NULL**. Mar mein **-30**, dip 📉

slides.title: [[Growth %]] bhi
slides.code:
SELECT month,
  ROUND(100.0 * (amount -
    LAG(amount) OVER w)
    / LAG(amount) OVER w, 1)
    AS pct
FROM sales
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY month_no);
slides.note: **100.0** likho, warna integer division se decimal ud jayega

slides.title: Pehle vs [[ab]]
slides.note: Next post mein **LEAD**: peeche nahi, **aage** dekhega 👀

slides.why: Bina ORDER BY "pichla" kaun? SQL Server error, baaki DB **random** 🎲
